3. Side length $s=1$: $N_1(3) = (3 - 1 + 1)^2 = 3^2 = 9$. (These are the unit hexagons making up the tiling).

Total number of regular hexagons $H(3) = N_1(3) + N_2(3) + N_3(3) = 9 + 4 + 1 = 14$.
